templates.title: Hearth
templates.description: Family location sharing you host yourself. Live map, place alerts, SOS and crash detection for iOS and Android.
templates.note: Put a reverse proxy with TLS in front before you invite anyone, because the app refuses a plain HTTP server on the internet. Guide: https://qureshi-dh.github.io/hearth/docs/install/self-hosting/

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.label: Public address
env.description: Where phones will reach Hearth, such as https://hearth.example.com

env.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
env.label: Your email
env.description: The admin account, created on the first start

env.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password
env.description: At least 10 characters. Only read on the first start

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.label: Token secret
env.description: 32 or more random characters, from openssl rand -hex 48

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password
env.description: Letters and digits only, from openssl rand -hex 24

env.name: TRUST_PROXY
env.label: Behind a reverse proxy
env.description: true once a proxy on this machine terminates TLS

env.name: HEARTH_BIND
env.label: Listen address
env.description: 127.0.0.1 when the proxy runs on the host itself. A proxy in another container should join this stack's network and reach api:4000 instead. 0.0.0.0 opens it to the LAN
